_meta.what: Growing map of Buildio.au content, offering, and positioning. Concepts, ideas, classic messaging points, page titles + notes, differences and similarities to competitors. Structured companion to the markdown docs in .claude/marketing-knowledge/.
_meta.how_to_use: Reference and update as new ideas, pages, copy versions, audiences, or messaging surface. Markdown files in the same folder hold narrative (voice rules, positioning principles); this file holds structured data — versioned content, audience records, page records, classic lines, decisions, open questions. Read both. Update both when relevant.
contains: Offering — what Buildio sells (services, engagements, deliverables)
Positioning — core message, wedge, pillars, differentiators, honest gaps
Audiences — concrete prospect personas with cross-references to pages and angles
Angles — core messaging cuts that map to audience and page
Competitors — alternatives Buildio is chosen against, with where-they-win and where-Buildio-wins
Classic messaging points — recurring lines and framings that have landed
Concepts — ideas and framings, separate from polished copy. Where new thinking lives before it's promoted to messaging.
Pages — site page records with titles, intent, status, content versions, wireframe sections, cross-references
principles: Nothing gets destroyed — content is versioned, not overwritten
Selections are recorded ('selected: true/false'), losing options remain visible for context
Open questions are tracked to resolution
The schema grows — new nodes added as needed; don't force ideas into the wrong shape
_meta.schema_status: scaffold — mostly empty, populate as we go

family_of_sites.role: Supporting brand presentation + UniPixel offload backend
UniPixel plugin dev base + docs hub

offering._note: What Buildio.au sells. Services, engagement models, typical deliverables. Source of truth for any 'what we do' messaging.

positioning._note: Structured positioning facts. Companion to positioning.md narrative.

messaging_points._note: Classic lines, framings, and recurring messages that have landed (or are being tested). Promoted from concepts when they prove themselves.

concepts._note: Ideas and framings before they're polished into messaging. Where new thinking lives. Promote to messaging_points.in_testing when worth trying live.

differences_and_similarities._note: Cross-cuts. Where Buildio is similar to or different from a competitor, an alternative approach, or a sibling brand. Useful when writing 'vs' content or sharpening positioning.

content_versions._note: Top-level versioned content not tied to a specific page (e.g. taglines, hero variants tested across multiple surfaces, recurring CTAs). Page-specific versions live inside the page record.

decisions_log.decision: Created content-offering-positioning.json as the structured brain for Buildio.au content and positioning, scoped narrower than the Midlands full-project brain (this brain is content/offering/positioning only; app/domain knowledge live in their own .claude/ folders).
decisions_log.rationale: Markdown handles narrative well but doesn't structure cross-references (audience → page → angle). JSON gives a queryable, versionable, growable map for content development without the markdown becoming a tangle of cross-links.

open_questions.question: What does Buildio.au actually sell? Service shape (project / retainer / advisory), typical deliverable, who buys, price range. Required to populate offering.* and positioning.*.

Who are the concrete prospect personas — by role, sector, company size, where they're searching, what brought them here? Required before audiences[] can be populated and before pages can be cross-referenced to audiences.

What are Buildio.au's actual competitors / alternatives the prospect considers? Big-4 (Deloitte/PwC etc.), boutique consultancies (named), in-house build, freelance, SaaS-only, status quo? Each needs a record with strength + where Buildio wins.

What's already on buildio.au — page titles, hero copy, sections, current CTAs? An extraction pass against the live site or local theme content (inc/home/* partials) populates pages[] with the current state as a starting baseline before iteration.
What is the single canonical CTA across the site? ('Book a discovery call', 'Talk to Buildio', etc.) Drives the writing-style.md placeholder and content_versions.ctas[].
